coverage_description: ASVS coverage map of the project: every OWASP ASVS requirement of a level as examined, unexamined, unsupported, not applicable or awaiting evidence, with the reason and the checks behind it. It shows what was examined, not whether the project meets the standard.
coverage_option_level: asvs: the level to show (1, 2 or 3) without changing the project's choice.
coverage_option_run: asvs: the Quality run to read (default: the last finished validation).
coverage_option_semantic_run: asvs: a Semantic run to read (default: the last finished run of each method); may repeat.
coverage_option_state: asvs: show only the requirements in this state (examined, unexamined, unsupported, not-applicable, awaiting-evidence).
coverage_option_chapter: asvs: show only this chapter (for example V5).
coverage_option_subdimension: asvs: show only the requirements of this Security subdimension (for example injection).
coverage_option_deterministic_only: asvs: leave out what only an AI review of the source examined.
coverage_option_reason: not-applicable: why the requirement, section or chapter does not apply to the project (required; 3 to 300 characters).
coverage_option_remove: not-applicable: take the decision out instead of recording it.
coverage_option_preview: level, not-applicable: show the entry and the change of the file and write nothing.
coverage_option_yes: level, not-applicable: write without asking after showing the entry.
coverage_unknown_map_fix: The only map is asvs: jgates coverage asvs.
coverage_unknown_subcommand_fix: Use: jgates coverage asvs | asvs level <1|2|3> | asvs not-applicable <id> --reason "<text>" | asvs undo <token>.
coverage_unexpected_argument_fix: Check the command with jgates help.
coverage_read_only: The ASVS decisions cannot be changed in governed (read-only) mode: the rules come from the CI policy ({env} is set).
coverage_read_only_fix: Run without the policy variable to edit this project's file.
coverage_undo_token_required: Give the undo token the write printed.
coverage_confirmation_required: There is no terminal to ask for confirmation and --yes was not given: nothing was written.
coverage_confirmation_required_fix: Run again with --yes to write the entry, with --preview to only look at it, or with --json.
coverage_refused_asvs_reason_invalid_fix: Give --reason with 3 to 300 characters and no control characters.
coverage_refused_asvs_target_required: Name the requirement, section or chapter.
coverage_refused_asvs_target_required_fi: For example: jgates coverage asvs not-applicable V5.1.1 --reason "<text>" (or a section such as V5.1, or a chapter such as V5).
coverage_refused_asvs_target_unknown_fix: Check the id in the map: jgates coverage asvs --level 3.
coverage_refused_asvs_already_not_applic: Remove it first with --remove, or leave it as it is.
coverage_refused_asvs_decision_not_found: See the decisions in .jgates/asvs.json or in the map.
coverage_refused_asvs_file_invalid: {file} cannot be read ({place}): {problem}. It was not rewritten.
coverage_refused_asvs_file_invalid_fix: Fix the file by hand (an object with "version", "level" and "notApplicable"), then try again.
coverage_refused_asvs_file_changed: The decisions file changed since it was read: nothing was written.
coverage_refused_asvs_file_unsafe_fix: The decisions file must be a regular file inside the project.
coverage_refused_asvs_write_failed_fix: Check the permissions of the project folder and try again.
coverage_refused_asvs_undo_invalid: The undo token is not valid.
coverage_refused_asvs_undo_invalid_fix: Give the token the write printed, as it was printed.
coverage_refused_asvs_run_not_found_fix: See the runs with jgates history.
coverage_refused_asvs_semantic_run_not_f: See the Semantic runs with jgates semantic history.
coverage_refused_asvs_data_missing: The ASVS data of this installation cannot be read: {detail}
coverage_refused_asvs_data_missing_fix: Reinstall JGates; the data folder vendor/owasp-asvs ships with it.
coverage_refused_asvs_mapping_missing: The ASVS mapping of this installation cannot be read: {detail}
coverage_refused_asvs_mapping_missing_fi: Reinstall JGates; the mapping pack packs/asvs ships with it.
coverage_refused_asvs_state_invalid_fix: Use examined, unexamined, unsupported, not-applicable or awaiting-evidence.
coverage_refused_asvs_chapter_unknown_fi: Use a chapter id from V1 to V17.
coverage_refused_asvs_subdimension_unkno: Use one of the Security subdimensions named in the message.
coverage_refused_asvs_decisions_unsafe_f: The decisions file must be a regular file inside the project.
coverage_statement: This map shows what was examined, not whether the project meets the standard.
coverage_reason_not_applicable: recorded as not applicable for {target} on {recorded}: {reason}
coverage_reason_examined_ai: examined only by an AI review of the source: {checks}
coverage_reason_unexamined: a mapped check could run on this project and did not. {details}
coverage_reason_awaiting_deployment: it needs a deployed system to be established; no JGates check examines it from the repository
coverage_reason_awaiting_person: it needs a person (a document, a process or an operational setting); no JGates check examines it from the repository
coverage_reason_unsupported_pending: no reviewed JGates check examines this (the mapping entry awaits its review)
coverage_reason_unsupported_other_stacks: the mapped checks do not exist for this project's stacks. {details}
coverage_check_ran_reused: ran to completion in {run}, reused from the cache (same inputs)
coverage_check_not_interpreted: its output was not interpreted, so it proves nothing: {detail}
coverage_check_no_executable_adapter: no adapter can run it here: {detail}
coverage_check_stage_not_completed: the Semgrep step did not complete: {detail}
coverage_check_plan_missing: the run stored no plan, so the rule files it used are unknown: validate again
coverage_check_pack_not_selected: the JGates rule pack was not selected for the Semgrep step
coverage_check_pack_other_version: the run used another version of the JGates rule pack: validate again
coverage_check_no_scanned_languages: the run was made before JGates recorded which languages Semgrep scanned: validate again
coverage_check_language_not_scanned: the scan covered no {language} file, the language of this rule
coverage_check_language_absent: the project has no {language} file, the language of this rule
coverage_check_run_unfinished: the Semantic run did not finish
coverage_check_not_reviewed: the Semantic review did not complete: {detail}
coverage_check_budget_exhausted: the review ran out of budget: {detail}
coverage_check_masking_blocked: nothing was sent: the masking blocked the review
coverage_check_invalid: the model's answer was not valid: {detail}
coverage_check_ledger_missing: the security audit has no coverage ledger
coverage_check_ledger_invalid: the coverage ledger of the security audit is not valid: {detail}
coverage_check_record_missing: the run has no record of the categories it searched
coverage_check_category_not_reported: the sweep did not report this category
coverage_check_no_file_scanned: the sweep found no file of this category in the project
coverage_check_no_quality_run: there is no validation of this workspace yet
coverage_check_not_in_plan: it was not in the plan of this validation
coverage_check_block_not_examined: the security audit examined no part of this attack class
coverage_check_deterministic_only: an AI review of the source, left out by "deterministic only"
coverage_check_unknown_rule: the rule is not in the JGates rule pack of this installation
coverage_check_no_validated_row: no proven support for this project's stacks (proven for: {stacks})
coverage_check_not_validated_for_stack: it ran, but its support is proven only for: {stacks}
coverage_warning_revisions_differ: The runs analyzed different revisions: Quality run {qualityRun} analyzed {qualityRevision}, Semantic run {semanticRun} analyzed {semanticRevision}.
coverage_warning_no_quality_run: There is no finished validation of this workspace yet: no deterministic check ran.
coverage_warning_decisions_invalid: {file} cannot be read ({problem}): its decisions are not applied and it is not rewritten.
coverage_warning_decisions_other_version: {file} holds decisions for ASVS {version}; this map is ASVS {asvsVersion}, so they are not applied.
coverage_text_level_default: level 1 until the project records another
coverage_text_deterministic_only: Deterministic only: what only an AI review of the source examined is left out.
coverage_text_runs_no_quality: Quality run read: none (no finished validation yet)
coverage_text_totals: Examined: {examined} ({examinedDeterministic} by a deterministic check, {examinedAiOnly} only by an AI review of the source) | Unexamined: {unexamined} | Unsupported: {unsupported} | Not applicable: {notApplicable} | Awaiting evidence: {awaitingEvidence} | {rows, plural, one {# requirement} other {# requirements}}
coverage_text_attribution: Requirement text: OWASP ASVS {version}, © The OWASP Foundation, {licence} ({sourceUrl}, {licenceUrl})
coverage_text_open_findings: {count, plural, =0 {no open finding} one {# open finding} other {# open findings}}
coverage_text_removed_not_applicable: The decision on {id} was removed from {file}.
coverage_text_undo_hint: To undo: jgates coverage asvs undo {token}
coverage_text_undone: {file} is back as it was before the write.
